Name: Sujeet Kumar
Bio: Sujeet Kumar is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha. Sujeet is a Co-founder of Udaan. He founded Udaan in 2016 with Vaibhav Gupta and Amod Malviya, who were both former senior executives at Flipkart. Prior to founding Udaan, Sujeet was President of Operations at Flipkart, where he built operations, supply chain, and logistics, which accounted for more than half of Flipkart's sales. He was instrumental in setting up the backbone of the distribution network of e-commerce in India.
